content.text: On Wednesday, aiming to finish off a series sweep, Shohei Ohtani takes the mound for the Los Angeles Dodgers (13-4) against Clay Holmes and the New York Mets (7-11), with first pitch scheduled for 10:10 p.m. ET. If you’re intending to watch this game, keep reading for streaming and TV options for the Los Angeles-New York matchup. When is Dodgers vs. Mets and when does it start? This contest between the Dodgers and Mets is on Wednesday, April 15, 2026. You should expect the opening pitch at 10:10 p.m. ET. Where to watch Dodgers vs. Mets The Dodgers and Mets will take to the field at Dodger Stadium for this matchup on April 15, and if you would like to see the matchup live, get your tickets now from Vivid Seats! What channel is the game on? You can catch this game live on ESPN. Watch the Dodgers vs. Mets live stream on Fubo Live Stream Online: Sign up for Fubo today! Dodgers vs. Mets Game Preview Yesterday, the Dodgers picked up a 2-1 victory over the Mets, with Blake Treinen (0.1 IP, 0 R, 0 H, 1 K) registering the win for the Dodgers. Kyle Tucker went 1 for 3 with an RBI to lead the offensive attack. Brooks Raley (1.0 IP, 1 R, 1 H, 1 K) was credited with the loss for the Mets. Dodgers Stats, Odds & Insights The Dodgers have been the moneyline favorite 17 total times this season. They’ve finished 13-4 in those games. The Los Angeles Dodgers lead baseball with 29 total home runs, averaging 1.7 per game. The Dodgers have a league-high .477 slugging percentage. Los Angeles has a 3.26 team ERA that ranks fourth across all MLB pitching staffs. Pitchers for the Dodgers combine for the No. 3-ranked WHIP in MLB (1.099). Mets Stats, Odds & Insights The Mets have entered the game as underdogs four times this season and won twice. New York ranks 23rd in Major League Baseball with 14 home runs. The Mets rank 26th in the majors with a .336 team slugging percentage. New York has the ninth-best ERA (3.58) in the majors this season. The Mets have a combined WHIP of 1.244 as a pitching staff, which ranks 11th in MLB.
